pipeline._comment_seed: null = different results every run (recommended). Set an integer here to reproduce a specific run exactly.

camera._comment_motion: Motion blur parameters — how far the camera moves between animation frames
camera._comment_dof: Focus-stack effect: each blur shot gets its own random aperture + focus distance, and the focus racks slightly (focus_rack_range) during the simulated exposure, same as the camera motion does.

lighting._comment_hdri: Set randomise_hdri true once you have .hdr/.exr files in hdri_directory. Overrides the sun+flat-sky lighting above.

scene_objects._comment: Names of objects to randomise position/rotation for. If using the built-in procedural test scene and these are left empty, the pipeline auto-fills them with the test primitives (Cube, Sphere, etc). Once you load your own .blend via blender.scene_file, list your actual object names here.

blender._comment_scene: Path to your .blend scene file. Leave empty to use a procedural scene.
